display.purpose: Landing/marketing hero headlines only; not used inside tool screens.

headline.purpose: Active tool name, big result numbers.

body.purpose: Slider labels, input values, result copy.

label.purpose: Uppercase structural chrome: nav pills, header subtitle.

shadows.name: glass-separation
shadows.purpose: Separates a frosted panel from the page background. Structural, not interactive.

shadows.name: accent-glow
shadows.purpose: Signals a live/active state (active nav pill, slider thumb, icon badge) in the current tool's own accent color.

motion.name: tap-compress
motion.purpose: Framer Motion press feedback on every tactile button (Numpad keys, CTAs).

motion.name: value-roll
motion.value: initial: { y: -10, opacity: 0 }, animate: { y: 0, opacity: 1 }
motion.purpose: Odometer-style reveal whenever a computed result value changes.

motion.name: haptic-tick
motion.purpose: Fires on every whole-unit slider change while dragging, and on every Numpad key press. Primary feedback channel; visual glow is secondary.

components.name: Primary Pill Button (Numpad Next)
components.description: Full-width accent CTA that advances to the next input field.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: rgba(103,232,249,0.1); color: #67E8F9; border: 1px solid rgba(103,232,249,0.3); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 16px 24px; font-weight: 700; backdrop-filter: blur(18px); transition: background 0.15s ease-out, transform 0.1s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(103,232,249,0.16); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #67E8F9; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: rgba(103,232,249,0.2); transform: scale(0.9); }

components.name: Ghost Key (Numpad digit)
components.description: Tactile numeric keypad button replacing the OS keyboard.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 16px; aspect-ratio: 16/9; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; backdrop-filter: blur(18px); transition: background 0.15s ease-out, transform 0.1s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #67E8F9; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); transform: scale(0.9); }

components.name: Nav Pill (active)
components.description: Active tool tab in the horizontal tool switcher, glowing in that tool's own accent.
components.css: .ds-nav-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.22em; border: 1px solid transparent; outline: none; } .ds-nav-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #67E8F9; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-pill--active { background: rgba(103,232,249,0.16); border-color: rgba(103,232,249,0.34); color: #67E8F9; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(103,232,249,0.3); } .ds-nav-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #67E8F9; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(103,232,249,0.55); }

components.name: Nav Pill (inactive)
components.description: Inactive tool tab, neutral gray, no glow.
components.css: .ds-nav-pill--inactive { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #94A3B8; } .ds-nav-dot--inactive { background: rgba(148,163,184,0.55); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Haptic Slider
components.description: Signature drag-to-set input: recessed track, accent fill, glowing floating thumb, vibrates on whole-unit change.
components.css: .ds-slider { position: relative; height: 80px; background: #0F172A; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); } .ds-slider-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 40%; background: rgba(103,232,249,0.2); } .ds-slider-thumb { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 40%; width: 48px; height: 48px; margin-top: -24px; margin-left: -24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #67E8F9; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255,255,255,0.3); transition: transform 0.15s ease-out; }

components.name: Active Tool Icon Badge
components.description: Small glowing icon chip in the app header showing the current tool's icon in its accent color.
components.css: .ds-icon-badge { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(103,232,249,0.14); color: #67E8F9; box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(103,232,249,0.12); }

narrative.overview: MedUtils reads as an instrument panel, not a form. A near-black base (#07111D) with a faint cyan radial glow at the top holds the whole app in a low-light register, built for a shift where the room lights are already dimmed. Against that base, each of the six tools carries its own signal color, the way leads on a monitor each get their own trace color. Depth comes from glow and blur, never from a drop shadow. Every touch target answers back: a haptic click, a scale-down on tap, a glow when a value is live.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy-black base, never pure black, never light mode
One signal accent per tool, applied with intent, never blanket-colored
Depth via blur + glow, not shadows
Pill-shaped nav and CTAs; rounded-2xl for tactile surfaces
Uppercase, wide-tracked micro-labels for structural chrome only

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: A screen shows exactly one tool accent at a time, plus neutral chrome. Never mix two tool accents on the same screen outside the tool switcher itself.

rules.name: The Rare Display Rule
rules.body: .font-display is reserved for landing/marketing headlines. Inside the tools, headline weight (not a font swap) carries emphasis.

rules.name: The No Gray Shadow Rule
rules.body: If a shadow is needed, it either separates glass from background (blur) or signals liveness (accent-colored glow). A neutral gray drop-shadow doesn't appear anywhere in this system.

dos: Do give each tool exactly one accent color, sourced from shiftsideTools[].accent / .rgb — never hardcode a different hex for the same tool elsewhere.
Do use glow and blur for depth, never a gray drop-shadow.
Do pair every haptic/glow feedback moment with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
Do keep uppercase wide-tracked labels to structural chrome only — nav, eyebrows, subtitles.
donts: Don't ship a sterile, white, Epic/EHR-style form screen.
Don't default to a soft consumer-wellness palette.
Don't mix two tools' accent colors on one screen outside the tool switcher itself.
Don't use a plain gray box-shadow anywhere.
Don't use background-clip: text gradients beyond the existing white→slate-400 numeral treatment.
Don't reuse Notes Coral as a generic danger color outside its own tool screens.
